## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Research-methods/documentation clarification
- [ ] Test or reproducibility improvement
- [ ] Software feature
- [ ] Hardware-interface or bench-prototype documentation
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Evidence and validation

- [ ] I ran relevant tests or explain why tests were not applicable.
- [ ] I documented changed assumptions, inputs, outputs, and limitations.
- [ ] I did not use Set B to fit, select, calibrate, or tune a model or threshold.
- [ ] I did not claim clinical validation or clinical readiness.

Commands/results:

## Safety, privacy, and provenance

- [ ] No patient-level data, identifiers, credentials, tokens, or private datasets are included.
- [ ] Any data or external material has documented provenance and permission.
- [ ] Hardware changes remain bench-only and do not invite connection to a person.
- [ ] I have identified third-party material and its licence, if any.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Existing data contracts and tests remain compatible, or breaking changes are explained.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant tests were updated.
